title: Topview AIのCanvas機能で、読み込んだ画像や音声データをアップスケールしてからキャンバス上で指定し、Seedance 2.5の動画生成に使う
content:
Topview AIのCanvas機能で、読み込んだ画像や音声データをアップスケールしてからキャンバス上で指定し、Seedance 2.5の動画生成に使う  
音楽を聴きながらChatGPTにマイク入力で構成案を口頭で伝え、MVの構成とSeedance用プロンプトを作らせる  
Seedance 2.5は参照（リファレンス）を多く使えるので、Canvas上で参照素材を整理してプロンプトから参照しやすい形にして生成する

en.content:
Use Topview AI’s Canvas feature to upscale imported image and audio data, specify them on the canvas, and use them for video generation in Seedance 2.5.  
While listening to music, verbally tell ChatGPT your composition ideas via microphone input, and have it create the MV structure and a prompt for Seedance.  
Since Seedance 2.5 can use a large number of references, organize reference materials on the Canvas and generate in a way that makes them easy to reference from the prompt.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
In response to the demand for “wanting to generate more casually,” we pushed ourselves to the limit.

This time, the Ultra annual plan includes:
・Unlimited use of Seedance 2.5 for 60 days
・Unlimited use of Wan 3.0 for 365 days 🔥

For regular use as well, Seedance 2.5 starts at about 19 yen per second, making it a very great deal ✨
Please try out the latest models to your heart’s content. https://t.co/5kAQaNUEKh

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] As mentioned earlier, Topview’s Canvas is just incredibly easy to use!

You can upscale imported image and audio data and specify them for video directly from the Canvas.
It’s much more intuitive to operate than other companies’ Canvas tools, and it feels really great (seriously).

This time, while listening to music, I used ChatGPT to loosely talk through the structure via microphone input, had it think through the composition, and then created the prompt.

With Seedance 2.5 now able to use many references, having a Canvas feature that makes it easy to reference materials in prompts feels like an enormous advantage.

Also, as mentioned in the quote, it seems to be very affordable compared with other companies, and there’s apparently an unlimited option too!
Please check it out!

@TopviewAIJP
